annotations.annotation_text: Page 428 opens Book 3, Chapter 1 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)") during the Age of Men phase. This passage continues Shaun floating down the Liffey in a barrel, delivering his sermon, the well-fed postman who delivers messages he cannot understand, featuring Shaun, Issy, the Rainbow Girls. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic node on page 428 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)"): Joyce weaves multilingual puns across 60+ languages — etymological roots from the Contemporary Literature Press lexicons (Romanian, Scandinavian, Slavic, Classical) intersect with local Dublin speech rhythms. The Age of Men dream-logic transforms ordinary syntax into a palimpsest of global literary and mythic references.

annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "slumber" on page 428 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within Shaun floating down the Liffey in a barrel, delivering his sermon, the well-fed postman who delivers messages he cannot understand. During this Age of Men phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
